findings.area: Round-9 reviewer identity + teacher rename uniqueness (name_taken)
findings.title: The 'a teacher cannot take a colleague's name' guard is bypassed by registration, by invisible/compatibility/homoglyph characters and by a cross-process race; a name can also mimic the id suffix
findings.evidence: Probe scripts: scratchpad/r10-A/rename.mjs, race.mjs, tokx.mjs (server :4401/:4402). Colleague 'Prof Alpha<tag>'. PUT /api/profile {name} from teacher B: lower/upper/double-space/padded/accented/NBSP/combining/ideographic-space -> 409 name_taken (guard works), but 'Prof \u200bAlpha..' (ZWSP), 'Al\u200bpha', 'Al\u00adpha' (soft hyphen), fullwidth 'ＰＲＯＦ Alpha..', Cyrillic 'о' in Prof, trailing '.' -> all 200. POST /api/auth/register {name:'Prof Alpha<tag>', teacherInviteCode:'INV'} (EXACT colleague name) -> 201 (id 57); registering as 'Dr. Claire Moreau' (the demo teacher) -> 201 (id 58). Two processes on one DB (4402 + 4412), both teachers renamed to the same fresh name simultaneously: both 200 in 13 of 25 rounds. A teacher registered as 'Dr. Claire Moreau (teacher #1)' then PUT /content/missions/mic-02/status -> reviewedBy = 'Dr. Claire Moreau (teacher #1) (teacher #70)'.
findings.repro: node scratchpad/r10-A/rename.mjs (port 4401, TEACHER_INVITE_CODE=INV); node scratchpad/r10-A/race.mjs (needs two servers on the same DB: 4402 and 4412); node scratchpad/r10-A/tokx.mjs for the suffix lookalike.
findings.expected: name_taken is enforced at every place a teacher name is set (registration too), folds invisible (Cf) and compatibility (NFKC) variants, is race-free (DB-level or inside a write transaction), and a display name cannot imitate the '(teacher #n)' suffix.
findings.actual: Only PUT /profile by an existing teacher is checked, with NFD+lowercase+whitespace folding; registration with the invite code, zero-width/soft-hyphen/fullwidth/homoglyph names, parentheses/'#' in the name and a two-process rename race all produce a second teacher that reads as the colleague. The '(teacher #id)' suffix keeps the audit record unambiguous for whoever reads the tail, but the visible reviewer name is spoofable, which is exactly what the guard was added to prevent.
findings.fix_hint: be/src/game.ts:56 foldName: NFKC + strip /[\p{M}\p{Cf}]/ + collapse \s; call the same check from be/src/routes.ts:~100 (register, role==='teacher') and from resetDemoTeacher; run the check+UPDATE inside tx() (BEGIN IMMEDIATE) or store a UNIQUE(name_key) column for teachers; reject '(', ')' and '#<digits>' in teacher names, or render the label as 'teacher #id - Name' so the identity comes first.

findings.title: Teacher demo reset rewrites the GLOBAL content-review state, silently reverting approvals made by other (real) teachers
findings.evidence: scratchpad/r10-A/reset.mjs on :4402 (DEMO_MODE=1). Real teacher 'Real Teacher R' (id 42) moves hem-01 draft->reviewed->approved. Demo teacher token then POST /api/demo/reset -> 200. GET /api/content/missions: hem-01 status 'draft', reviewedBy null. content_audit tail: '4|hem-01|approved|draft|1|Dr. Claire Moreau (teacher #1) [demo reset]'. The class deletion is correctly limited to the demo teacher (real teacher's class 'Real class keep' and its member survived).
findings.repro: node scratchpad/r10-A/reset.mjs (port 4402); inspect hem-01 in the output and content_audit in scratchpad/r10-A/a2.db.
findings.expected: A reset of the shared demo teacher touches only what the demo teacher produced (its own reviews, classes, profile); another teacher's approvals survive.
findings.actual: resetDemoTeacher runs UPDATE content_status ... WHERE status <> 'draft' OR reviewed_by IS NOT NULL on every mission regardless of reviewer. Anyone who can call POST /auth/demo then POST /demo/reset (no rate limit) can undo every other teacher's review work on a server that has DEMO_MODE=1 (and ALLOW_DEMO_IN_PRODUCTION=1 if ever used). Mitigated by the append-only audit row, and by DEMO_MODE being non-production, hence P2.
findings.fix_hint: be/src/demo.ts:~290-295: restrict both the audit loop and the UPDATE to rows whose reviewed_by = reviewerLabel(<any demo-teacher name>, uid) (or whose last content_audit actor_id = uid); leave rows reviewed by other actor ids alone. Optionally rate limit /demo/reset (it is the only unthrottled mutating route).

findings.title: npm run db:backup writes the backup (e-mails + scrypt hashes) world-readable (0644) into a 0755 directory
findings.evidence: umask 022: DB_PATH=a2.db node scripts/db-backup.ts bk/out1.db -> 'drwxr-xr-x bk' and '-rw-r--r-- out1.db' while a2.db/-wal/-shm are -rw-------. Live DB, WAL and SHM stay 0600 after open, checkpoint(TRUNCATE) and restart (SQLite gives sidecars the main file's mode), and an existing 0644/0444 DB is tightened on open; those parts HOLD.
findings.repro: cd be && DB_PATH=<db> node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning scripts/db-backup.ts /tmp/x/out.db; ls -la /tmp/x
findings.expected: Backup file 0600 (directory 0700) like the database it copies.
findings.actual: VACUUM INTO creates the file with the process umask (0644).
findings.fix_hint: be/scripts/db-backup.ts: process.umask(0o077) before mkdirSync/VACUUM INTO, or chmodSync(out, 0o600) right after (and before verification). Note: the shipped be/data/escape-lab.db is still 0644 at rest until the server opens it once.

findings.area: Hint persistence (hint_log.text) - provider returning an empty string
findings.title: An assistant that returns '' is charged 15 XP, delivers an empty hint and stores an empty text that hintsGiven then omits
findings.evidence: scratchpad/r10-A/hintinproc.mjs (in-process createApp with a custom HintProvider returning ''): POST /hint -> 200 source 'standard', hint === '' (not the faculty text); GET /attempts/:id -> hintsUsed 1, penaltyXp -15, step.hintsGiven []. Provider throwing or returning null correctly gives the faculty text stored with source 'standard'.
findings.expected: Empty/blank provider output falls back to the faculty hint.
findings.actual: game.ts hintLocked: const finalText = text ?? step.hints[level - 1] - '' is not nullish, so the empty string is delivered and stored. Unreachable with the built-in AnthropicHintProvider (it returns null for empty text), so only a custom HintProvider triggers it.
findings.fix_hint: be/src/game.ts (hintLocked, `const finalText = text ?? ...`): use `text || step.hints[level - 1]!` or normalise `text = text?.trim() || null` before computing source.

findings.title: Per-event penaltyXp (-10 wrong / -15 hint) and attempt.penaltyXp disagree once the cap bites: the total can stay flat or even become LESS negative after a hint
findings.evidence: scratchpad/r10-A/capwrong.mjs on hem-01: wrong #15 attempt.penaltyXp -150; wrong #16..#20 answer.penaltyXp = -10 each but attempt.penaltyXp stays -150 (delta 0); then POST /hint -> hint.penaltyXp -15 while attempt.penaltyXp goes -150 -> -130 (delta +20, because the no-hint bonus left the budget). Invariants asked for HOLD: in 1,658 randomised checks over all 10 missions/6 engines (wrong 0..20, hints, time) penaltyXp == independent computeScore oracle, never positive, never exceeds the final ledger penalty, completed-view penalty == ledger penalty.
findings.repro: node scratchpad/r10-A/capwrong.mjs (port 4401); node scratchpad/r10-A/play1.mjs 4401 8 for the oracle run.
findings.expected: A toast/response that says '-15 XP' should correspond to a change in the displayed penalty, or the response should report the applied amount.
findings.actual: Event amounts are constants; the cumulative figure is capped and can move in the opposite direction. Only visible for attempts that have already lost everything they could earn.
findings.fix_hint: be/src/game.ts answer()/hintLocked(): return penaltyXp as (penaltyAfter - penaltyBefore) of attemptView, or add appliedXp next to the nominal amount and document that the cap includes the lost no-hint bonus.

findings.title: HOST edge values crash with an unhandled 'error' event, HOST=localhost binds IPv6-only on macOS, and the startup log prints a malformed IPv6 URL
findings.evidence: DEMO_MODE=1 PORT=4411: HOST='' -> 127.0.0.1 (ok); HOST='::' -> dual-stack ok; HOST='localhost' -> listens on [::1] only (IPv4 127.0.0.1 and Node 18 clients refused); HOST='  127.0.0.1 ' and HOST=bogus.invalid -> process dies with 'node:events: Unhandled error event ... getaddrinfo ENOTFOUND' stack trace; log line for '::' is 'listening on http://:::4411'. With the default 127.0.0.1 bind, Node 18 http/fetch to http://localhost:PORT fails with ECONNREFUSED (localhost resolves to ::1 first, no happy-eyeballs) while Node 20/22 succeed. Engines are >=22.18 for both be and web, so the default is fine for supported runtimes. A generic env name also invites collisions (zsh/tcsh set HOST to the machine name).
findings.repro: HOST=bogus.invalid DEMO_MODE=1 PORT=4411 node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning src/server.ts ; HOST=localhost ... then curl http://127.0.0.1:4411/api/health (fails).
findings.expected: A clear one-line startup error for an unusable HOST; log URL bracketed for IPv6; ideally a service-specific variable name.
findings.actual: Raw unhandled 'error' stack trace, unbracketed IPv6 in the log.
findings.fix_hint: be/src/server.ts: app.server.on('error', e => { console.error('Cannot listen on ' + host + ':' + port + ': ' + e.message); process.exit(1); }); host.trim(); format '[::]'; consider LISTEN_HOST.

findings.area: Round-9 demo-domain refusal (isDemoEmail) with DEMO_MODE off
findings.title: Real accounts registered on @demo.escape-lab.app before round 9 are silently locked out (login 401, existing tokens 401) after the upgrade
findings.evidence: scratchpad/r10-A/legacy.mjs: pre-r9 code (snapshot) POST /auth/register bob@demo.escape-lab.app -> 201 with token. Same DB under the current code with DEMO_MODE off: POST /auth/login with Bob's own password -> 401 'Incorrect email or password.' Tokens minted under demo mode for the seeded accounts are rejected with demo off (HOLDS, as intended); tokens of every non-demo-domain account keep working (verified).
findings.repro: node scratchpad/r10-A/legacy.mjs <db>, then start the current server on it without DEMO_MODE and POST /api/auth/login.
findings.expected: Only the seeded accounts are refused, or the lock-out is announced/migrated.
findings.actual: The refusal keys on the e-mail suffix, not on 'is a seeded account', so any pre-existing registrant on that domain is caught.
findings.fix_hint: be/src/app.ts:~96 and be/src/routes.ts login: flag seeded users (users.is_demo for all 39, set in seedDemo) and refuse on the flag; keep the suffix check only for new registrations. Or add a release note / startup warning counting such rows.

findings.area: Round-9 'labs completed' sweep - sibling figure left over
findings.title: Overall mission progress uses 10 missions (Master included) on the student dashboard but 9 (Master excluded) on every teacher view
findings.evidence: Demo student Alex after /demo/reset: GET /api/dashboard -> overall {completedMissions:5,totalMissions:10,pct:50}; teacher roster/detail for the same student progressPct 56 (5 of STANDARD_MISSION_COUNT=9). Labs-completed itself is now consistent: dashboard, profile (3 of 3), leaderboard rows and 'me', roster, student detail and analytics labsEscaped were checked for a student who escaped all 4 labs (play2.mjs) and for a half-way student; all show 3 / 1 correctly and the Master Lab is never counted. HOLDS.
findings.repro: node scratchpad/r10-A/play2.mjs 4401 and compare dashboard.overall.pct with roster progressPct.
findings.expected: One definition of overall progress (or an explicit note in /api/rules).
findings.fix_hint: be/src/game.ts dashboard(): totalMissions = STANDARD_MISSION_COUNT and count only standard completions (or document the Master as extra in scoringRules).

findings.title: A valid token is also accepted with arbitrary trailing segments or padding ('<tok>.junk', '<tok>..', '<sig>=', '<sig>\n')
findings.evidence: scratchpad/r10-A/tokx.mjs: GET /api/me with u.token -> 200; with u.token+'.junk' -> 200; +'..' -> 200; signature + '=' -> 200; signature + newline -> 200.
findings.expected: Exactly one accepted string per token (strict 2-segment, canonical base64url).
findings.actual: `const [body, sig] = token.split('.')` ignores extra segments and Buffer.from(...,'base64url') is lenient. No present exploit (there is no revocation list), but any future denylist/cache keyed on the raw token string is bypassable.
findings.fix_hint: be/src/auth.ts verifyToken: split and require length === 2, and compare against the re-encoded signature string.

findings.area: Hint persistence while an AI hint is being generated
findings.title: A reload during an in-flight (AI) hint shows hintsUsed=1 / penalty -15 but hintsGiven=[]; the text only appears after the commit
findings.evidence: hintinproc.mjs with a gated provider: GET /attempts/:id mid-flight -> hintsUsed 1, hintsOnStep 1, hintsGiven [], penaltyXp -15; a concurrent second hint and an answer both 409 hint_in_progress (correct); after the provider resolves the row and text are stored and the refund path (clock past the limit mid-flight) restores counters exactly with no log row (hint_log/step_results/attempts stay consistent in the 2-process run, 20 users x 6 parallel hint calls over 2 processes: 0 anomalies). KNOWN_LIMITATIONS covers only the SIGTERM case.
findings.expected: Either hold the reservation out of hintsUsed until delivery or expose a pending flag so the client re-polls.
findings.actual: Count and penalty are visible before the text. Only with LAB_ASSISTANT_* configured (up to the 4 s provider timeout).
findings.fix_hint: be/src/game.ts attemptView: add hintPending = this.hintInFlight.has(a.id) to the step view, or document next to the SIGTERM note.

notes: No P0/P1. Method: ~30,000 HTTP requests plus in-process createApp harnesses against my own instances (:4401 NODE_ENV=test+DEMO, :4402 default limits+DEMO, :4403 demo off, :4404 killed -9 under load, :4412 second process on the 4402 DB, :4421/:4422/:44xx for old-schema and race cases). All servers I started are stopped (pids on 4501/4601/4603 belong to other waves). Item 1 HOLDS: labsCompleted/labsEscaped/labs/labsTotal checked on dashboard, profile, leaderboard rows+me, roster, student detail and analytics with 0..4 labs escaped incl. Master (play1.mjs, play2.mjs): always <=3, Master never counted; /api/rules text matches. Item 2: fresh DB, -wal, -shm 0600; an existing 0644 DB and a 0444 DB are tightened on open; sidecars follow the main file after checkpoint(TRUNCATE) and restart; a read-only directory or /dev/null path fails openDb with a clear SQLite/ENOTDIR error (no silent insecure fallback; unavoidable crash). Gap: backup output (R10-A-03). Item 3: '' -> loopback in demo mode, '::' dual-stack, '0.0.0.0' IPv4-only, 'localhost' -> ::1 only on this macOS; Node 18 clients cannot reach a 127.0.0.1 bind via 'localhost' (out of supported engines); see R10-A-06. Item 4: with demo off, demo accounts (student/teacher, right/wrong password, upper/space variants, missing demo-domain user) all return the identical 401 body; login median 33.6/33.6/34.0/34.2/32.9 ms for demo-right, demo-wrong, real-wrong, ghost, missing-demo-user (no distinguishable timing); the failed-login counter counts them (429 after 8 per ip+email, case variants share the bucket); reserved_email 400 for case, plus-addressing, ZWSP-in-local-part and uppercase domain; trailing dot / subdomain / Cyrillic-o / fullwidth / ZWSP-suffix variants register as ordinary non-demo addresses (harmless, they cannot reach the seeded rows); demo-minted student and teacher tokens -> 401 on /me, /dashboard, /demo/reset with demo off, real tokens unaffected, /auth/demo 404. See R10-A-07 for the upgrade hazard. Item 5: see R10-A-01; reviewer label verified in content_status.reviewed_by, content_audit.actor_name and GET /content/missions; a student may take a teacher's name (no effect on identity). Item 6: matrix no token 401, real student 403 not_demo, real teacher 403 not_demo, demo student resets only Alex (200, XP 8240), demo teacher resets only the teacher (200, idempotent twice, 30 parallel student resets all 200 and identical state), demo off 404 (real token) / 401 (demo token); visitor classes beyond the first two (7 -> 2) and their members deleted, a real teacher's class and member untouched; [demo reset] audit rows written once per non-draft mission and the audit chain stays valid; kill -9 during a loop of 200 concurrent resets/creates/reviews/plays then db:check clean and 14 SQL invariants clean (hint counters vs hint_log vs step_results, best score, xp_events, fragments vs exits, audit chain vs content_status, duplicate badges). See R10-A-02. Item 7: 60 parallel POST /classes -> exactly 50x201 + 10x409 class_limit_reached {limit:50}; 61st -> 429 rate_limited {retryAfterSeconds:60} + Retry-After; PUT /profile and PUT content status share the same budget (429), GET /classes unaffected, other teachers unaffected, 70 sequential profile saves -> 60 ok/10 429 (a human saving settings is never throttled; note the shared demo teacher/student accounts share one 60/min budget among all visitors, so one script can block everyone's settings writes for a minute); malformed names (' a', ZWSP) 400, emoji pair OK. Item 8: HOLDS (see R10-A-05 for the semantics note). Item 9: schema v5 DB built with the pre-r9 code (assistant L2 + standard L1, in-progress attempt) opens under the new code: v6, in-progress attempt shows only the recoverable standard hint, no_more_hints on the 3rd, db:check clean; 4-6 processes starting simultaneously on a v5 DB all come up with one migration; hintsGiven never contains unissued hints, explanation, recheck or key (335 responses scanned across all six engine types), belongs to the current step of an in_progress, non-expired attempt only (other user/attempt 404, completed -> step null, expired -> []); parallel hints across 2 processes (20 users x 6 calls): never more levels than hints, no duplicate level, counters == log == view; refund path leaves log and counters consistent; provider throw/null -> standard text stored. Item 10: openapi regenerated to scratch == be/openapi.json == live /api/openapi.json (0 drift); route x role matrix 93 combos, 0 mismatches (login 401 for dummy creds is expected); 22,540 fuzz requests (type confusion, proto pollution keys, NUL, lone surrogates, 20k-deep JSON, wrong content types, raw bodies) -> 0 5xx and every 4xx has {error:{code,message}}; 405 carries Allow, 413 at 64 KB, 415, 422, 429 shapes verified; real limits on :4402: answers 120/min then 429, hints 30/min, join 10/10min, login 8/account; be test suite 127/127 pass (no touch of be/data). Could not break: answer leak, state machine, double submit, token forgery, IDOR, cap race, migration race, kill -9 consistency. Observed but not filed: demo-reset is unthrottled and each cycle of reset+review adds append-only content_audit rows (bounded by the 60/min write budget); GET //host/api/... matches by pathname only (harmless); HEAD 405; match/order progress signal and the weak AI guard are documented; dashboard/leaderboard cohort=all and shared guest are documented.
